messages:
Nina - DevEx: Quick report: noticed odd loss of x-request-id + traceparent in a few sampleapps when auth refresh kicks in. Repro across languages. Otel hooks are on. Anyone else seeing retry+propagation gaps?

Omar - SDK: Yep. Common pattern: retry wrapper constructs a new request and forgets to copy headers or doesn't let instrumentation re-inject. Which sampleapps hit this?

Kei - SampleApps: Ran Node, Java, Rust examples. Node wrapper did `fetch(url, {method, body})` (no headers). Java example rebuilt HttpRequest without headers. Rust used reqwest and cloned body but not headers in the retry path.

Lina - Infra: Also saw logs where redact rules hid the header after it existed. One tenant had a demo regex `(?i).*id.*` which wipes x-request-id from logs. Two independent failure modes: header dropped vs header masked.

Nina - DevEx: Short repro (Node): `curl -i -H "x-request-id:r-999" -d '{}' http://localhost:3000/gen` -> logs show incoming id then later `outgoing headers {}` after retry.

Omar - SDK: Quick checklist: JS: use `request.clone()` or copy headers; Python: reuse PreparedRequest or pass headers=dict(prepared.headers); Java: use `HttpRequest.newBuilder(original).build()` to preserve headers; Rust/reqwest: clone headers via `req.headers().clone()`.

Kei - SampleApps: Pasted minimal Node retry that caused it: ```js
async function retryFetch(req) {
  const opts = { method: req.method, body: req.body } // lost headers
  return fetch(req.url, opts)
}
```

Kei - SampleApps: Fix was two lines: `const opts = { ...req, headers: req.headers }` and `await refreshToken()` before retry. Tests now pass. PR: https://rwd.in/pr/5010

Lina - Infra: Ops note: add staging integration: trigger 401 refresh and assert trace spans link. We'll fail builds if continuity broken.

Omar - SDK: Proposing SDK runtime safety: http instrumentation should emit a WARN (one-time per process) and increment metric `sdk.propagation.missing` when (active context has span) && (outgoing request lacks traceparent && x-request-id). Opt-out via env var `SDK_PROPAGATION_WARN=false`. Filing issue rwd.in/issue/1725.

Nina - DevEx: Love that. Also add an onboarding doc blurb: "Avoid greedy redact patterns like `.*id.*`. Prefer explicit allowlist or `(?i)^(authorization|cookie)$`".

Kei - SampleApps: Added unit tests to each sampleapp that simulate 401->refresh and assert the retried request carries x-request-id. CI green locally. PRs queued for Node/Java/Rust.

DepsBot: Dependency scan: no relevant changes.

Lina - Infra: One more gotcha: Go users should use `req.Clone(ctx)` or `newReq.Header = req.Header.Clone()` inside RoundTripper wrappers to preserve both headers and context. Added snippet to docs.

Omar - SDK: We'll also add a small lint rule in JS SDK repo that flags `fetch(...` inside retry helpers without header copy. Advisory initially. Issue rwd.in/issue/1726.

Nina - DevEx: Action items: 1) Kei merges sampleapp PRs, 2) Omar implements runtime warn+metric and lint advisory, 3) Lina adds infra integration test, 4) Docs update about redact patterns and retry guidance. I'll track on board.

Kei - SampleApps: Merged Node PR, Java & Rust pending review. Verified staging trace continuity after Node merge.

Omar - SDK: Drafted runtime warn and metric PR, added env var opt-out. Will link the PR in the issue.

Nina - DevEx: Closing loop once all PRs merged and infra test green. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
